en.bodyHtml:
Remove error message at berichten in Roundcube uses the webmail URL from your welcome email. If it fails, check mailbox status and password reset in the panel.

Webmail is the fast truth test for mailbox problems.

What this article covers

We treat “Remove error message at berichten in Roundcube” as an incident: symptom → layer (mailbox, client and DNS auth) → correction → proof.

Unique checkpoints

This long-form guide is written for Remove error message at berichten in Roundcube (slug foutmelding-berichten-verwijderen-roundcube).

Signals from title/topic: foutmelding, berichten, verwijderen, roundcube. Stay in the matching layer — do not mix DNS edits with wp-admin fixes unless this topic explicitly requires it.

Scope

Internal classification: topic roundcube-delete — include that context in tickets about “Remove error message at berichten in Roundcube”.

  • Mailbox address
  • Panel login

How to execute

  1. Open the webmail URL (not a random /webmail on another domain).
  2. Sign in with full address + password.
  3. If login fails: reset password in DirectAdmin → Email Accounts.
  4. Check mailbox disk quota.
  5. Test Inbox/Sent and an external test message.
  6. Repeat the core check for “Remove error message at berichten in Roundcube” from a second network or private window.

  2. Restore from backup only if the live state is corrupt — selectively where possible.
  3. Open a ticket with slug/subject, domain and what you already rolled back.
